{{Top|leg}}
A '''Speeder ferry''' was a commercial vehicle regularly seen on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] hauling broken air- and [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] to repair shops. The speeder used a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] and a remote-slave hookup to transport its cargo. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the [[Palpatine Counter-Insurgency Front]], led by [[Kirtan Loor]], unsuccessfully attempted to use a speeder ferry, loaded with a vehicle filled with explosives, to destroy a [[bacta distribution center]].
